**Narratives in retrieved evidence**
Evidence is selected in index order, not a representative sample. Descriptions apply only to these retrieved posts; counts above cover the complete scope.
Summaries cover only the first 5 of 10 displayed groups.

**` news `** - 10 of 207 matching posts retrieved.
Posts tagged #news are largely syndicated headline-style items spanning local crime and weather plus international affairs: an Old Town business burglary [T4-004335](#T4-004335), ashes washing ashore [T4-000005](#T4-000005), a Saudi reform plan [T4-002158](#T4-002158), a Bolivar Peninsula evacuation order [T4-000272](#T4-000272), Tropical Storm Hermine on Florida's Gulf coast [T4-003280](#T4-003280), Syrian forces entering Palmyra [T4-009314](#T4-009314), Thailand's migrant-worker crackdown [T4-003780](#T4-003780), a Houthi role in a strike on a U.S. warship [T4-004161](#T4-004161), post-storm cleanup crews [T4-002737](#T4-002737), and Merkel on resolving Syria without Assad [T4-009258](#T4-009258).

**` blacklivesmatter `** - 10 of 141 matching posts retrieved.
The #BlackLivesMatter group mixes protest coverage, race-related incidents and commentary. It includes a Memphis interstate bridge blockade [T4-002764](#T4-002764), allegations of rotten bananas thrown at Black students at American University [T4-009406](#T4-009406), Idris Elba on a UK "feeling of uprising" after US police brutality [T4-009392](#T4-009392), and police-brutality/BLM framing [T4-009247](#T4-009247). Other posts are hostile or dismissive, blaming "Soros/Hillary professional RIOTERS" [T4-009417](#T4-009417) or attacking rap-era division [T4-009288](#T4-009288), while some are cultural or promotional, such as a Black-kid-in-school meme [T4-009246](#T4-009246) and a Beyonce reference [T4-009384](#T4-009384); one post is a bare condemnation [T4-009393](#T4-009393) and another a location/tag post [T4-009379](#T4-009379).

**` world `** - 10 of 111 matching posts retrieved.
Posts tagged #world are international hard-news headlines: Saudi economic reform [T4-002158](#T4-002158), Syrian government forces in Palmyra [T4-009314](#T4-009314), Thailand's migrant-worker crackdown [T4-003780](#T4-003780), a Houthi role in a strike on a U.S. warship [T4-004161](#T4-004161), Merkel on Syria without Assad [T4-009258](#T4-009258), EU scrutiny of Gabon's election [T4-003349](#T4-003349), a Munich shopping-mall shooting [T4-002862](#T4-002862), denial that an Iran payment was prisoner ransom [T4-002983](#T4-002983), arrests of suspected Islamist militants in Spain [T4-004142](#T4-004142), and Kerry discussing the Obama visit and North Korea [T4-003013](#T4-003013).

**` maga `** - 10 of 92 matching posts retrieved.
The #MAGA group is overwhelmingly pro-Trump advocacy: praise of Trump's competence [T4-003807](#T4-003807), the Senate tax bill as "another great step" [T4-009099](#T4-009099), "historic" first-term accomplishments [T4-008945](#T4-008945), Trump's Poland appearance [T4-008455](#T4-008455), and Giuliani heading a cyber-security committee [T4-005909](#T4-005909). Several posts attack opponents and media, urging calls against a Senator Collins-linked ad blamed on Soros and the "deep state" [T4-009068](#T4-009068), insulting an NBC poll and its sharers [T4-004144](#T4-004144), and promoting a Hannity segment with many mentions [T4-009120](#T4-009120). Others are slogan-only or allied-campaign tag stacks [T4-007884](#T4-007884) [T4-009031](#T4-009031).

**` tcot `** - 10 of 82 matching posts retrieved.
Posts tagged #tcot are short conservative commentary and call-to-action items, often stacked with #pjnet or #MAGA. Themes include anti-communism and Russian-hacking skepticism [T4-007837](#T4-007837) [T4-008134](#T4-008134), a defense of police against claims of impunity for killings [T4-002806](#T4-002806), anti-Sharia sentiment [T4-002804](#T4-002804), a call to remove a teacher over a student's test [T4-004047](#T4-004047), march promotion [T4-008600](#T4-008600), a freedom-themed cartoon with allied tags [T4-007884](#T4-007884), mockery of liberals [T4-006419](#T4-006419), and vague taunts or endorsements [T4-002652](#T4-002652) [T4-008280](#T4-008280).
